item.title: U.S. withdraws from military exercises with South Korea set for next month
item.description: The move comes as the Iran war strains U.S. military resources in Asia.

item.title: Bessent unveils sweeping new Iran sanctions but delays toughest blow
item.description: The treasury secretary said Trump is contacting other world leaders to demand their support for the “economic asphyxiation” of the Iranian regime but he declined to say which countries and gave no deadline for action.

item.title: Trump announces tariffs on Canadian vehicles, steel in escalation of trade war
item.description: President Donald Trump offered no additional details about the levies, but he said they would take effect Jan. 1 — leaving time for the two sides to resume negotiations.

item.title: Trump says U.S. could rename Lake Ontario as Lake America amid Canada trade war
item.description: The president cited his tariff fight in a social media post, saying the United States doesn’t expect to be “doing much business with Ontario any longer.”
